 Hanoi Police vs Johor DT Prediction, 7:30 PM, November 19th: Southeast Asian Showdown
 TPO - Football match preview: Hanoi Police vs Johor DT, Shopee Cup - Team news, expected lineup, form, and head-to-head history. The clash between Hanoi Police and Johor DT is truly the most accurate measure of the Vietnamese representative's ambition to rise to regional prominence against the number one force in Malaysian football, if not Southeast Asian football.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 19/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Match preview: Hanoi Police vs Johor DT
 In terms of status and potential, Johor Darul Ta'zim is truly a giant in Southeast Asia. Not only are they the reigning Malaysian champions and reached the semi-finals of the Shopee Cup last season, but Johor DT also boasts the most expensive squad in this year's tournament, with an estimated value approximately 2.5 times higher than the 6.45 million euros of Hanoi Police.
 That valuation gap clearly reflects the difference in squad depth and the visitors' extensive experience in continental competitions. Johor DT employs a modern style of play, emphasizing control of the midfield, maintaining constant pressure, and being particularly sharp in exploiting the spaces behind the opposing midfield.
 At this point, it's safe to say they are the number one force in ASEAN. Johor DT not only progressed deep into the AFC Champions League in recent seasons, but they are also the highest-ranked Southeast Asian team in this season's campaign. While Buriram is struggling, Johor DT is emerging as almost the only force capable of challenging the East Asian powerhouses in the classification round.
 On the other side of the pitch, Hanoi Police showed no signs of being inferior in terms of spirit or playing style. The police team is building a technically skilled squad that prefers ball control and possesses extremely flexible transitions. However, the biggest challenge for Coach Polking lies in balancing attack and defense. Hanoi Police's attack is strong, but their defense is quite weak, leading to frequent goals conceded recently. 
 Form and head-to-head history of Hanoi Police vs Johor DT
 You may also like Johor DT sent a strong warning to the rest of the league with a crushing 6-0 victory over Svay Rieng in the opening match of the Shopee Cup. Although their Cambodian opponents cannot be compared to Hanoi Police, Johor DT's explosive performance, scoring five goals in the second half alone, demonstrated their incredible attacking prowess and clinical finishing.
 Meanwhile, Hanoi Police also had a successful start at the Shopee Cup, defeating Lion City Sailors with a narrow 1-0 victory in Singapore . Looking more broadly across all competitions from the end of October to the beginning of November, coach Mano Polking's team is maintaining an impressive five-match unbeaten streak.
 They shared points with Dong A Thanh Hoa (1-1), created a sensation by defeating Shanghai Port 3-2 away from home, drew with Song Lam Nghe An (1-1), held Kyoto Sanga to a draw (0-0), and most recently achieved a convincing 2-1 victory against Ho Chi Minh City Police. This series of achievements proves that Hanoi Police has accumulated considerable composure when facing big teams, both regionally and continentally. 
 Bergson promises to pose many threats to CAHN. Both teams have the confidence to enter the match. But to be fair, Johor DT is more than capable of dominating the home team thanks to the quality of their squad.
 Information on the Hanoi Police vs. Johor DT match
 The personnel situation before kick-off is showing relatively positive signs for both sides. The only problem for Hanoi Police is the injury to Dinh Bac . Due to playing continuously in recent times and having just returned from a national team training camp, Dinh Bac has suffered an injury that will keep him sidelined for several weeks.
 Meanwhile, the most elite core of the Police football team remains fully ready for battle. Many key players such as Quang Vinh, Viet Anh, Nguyen Filip , Quang Hai, Thanh Long… were rested during the recent FIFA Days, further boosting Hanoi Police's morale.
 On the opposite side of the pitch, Johor Darul Ta'zim travels to Hanoi with almost their strongest squad, with no notable absences reported. During the recent FIFA Days, the Malaysian national team played two matches but did not field any members of Johor DT. Therefore, the visitors have the opportunity to field their full strength at Hang Day Stadium.
 You may also like Predicted lineups for Hanoi Police vs Johor DT 
 Hanoi Police: Nguyen Filip; Adou Minh, Viet Anh, Putros, Van Hau; Van Do, Stefan Mauk, Sabater; Leo Artur, Alan, 'Koko' Perea.
 Johor DT: Syihan Hazmi; Carlos Akapo, Cristian Glauder, Kevin Medina; Oscar Arribas, Dejan Petrovic, Nacho Mendez, Jonathan Silva; Arif Aiman, Bergson; Shahab Zahedi.
 Predicted score: Hanoi Police 1-1 Johor DT
